svg.text: EVEN AS A RELYING PARTY ONLY, THE CLIENT DEPENDS ON EMUDHRA FOR

g.text: Validating a signature calls eMudhra's OCSP responder or CRL. Long-term
validation helps only if it was embedded at signing.
Not hypothetical: 17–20 Oct 2026, Chrome, Mozilla, Apple and Microsoft
blocked eight eMudhra intermediates whose private keys were recoverable.
Chrome removes emSign ECC Root CA - G3 from 27 Oct.
Valid under Indian law. Whether it counts as qualified in the EU, or
elsewhere, depends on the certificate type and jurisdiction.

svg.text: AI / TRUST / BOUNDARY LOCKOUT: WHAT STOPS WHEN A CHAIN IS DISTRUSTED

g.text: Agent → TLS handshake → blocked chain → no call
Agents, AI gateways and MCP tools calling an API whose certificate
chains through a blocked intermediate fail the handshake: the tool call
Mandates signed with keys from an exposed environment must be rejected,
and code-signed packages and adapters fail verification.
Browser, OS, Node, Composer, certifi reject the chain
A distrusted chain is not a warning: browsers and runtimes refuse the
connection, so the site or API is unreachable.
Signed documents on that chain show as invalid wherever they are opened.
Edge ↔ origin, webhooks, feed syncs, partner APIs
Every boundary crossing is a TLS handshake. A distrusted chain on either
side stops the crossing: feeds stall, webhooks fail.
Consent, opt-out and deletion events stop propagating: a DSR lockout.
Queue them and replay once the chain is reissued.

svg.text: Recover faster: know which certificates chain through which CA, automate reissue (ACME) with a second CA ready, and sign records with keys you own and can verify offline.
WHEN IT IS BY PROXY, THESE BECOME CONCRETE

Anyone verifies offline, with no account and no CA chain that can be distrusted. Short links at /v/<hash>; print
Your domain, your TLS certificate, your trust store
Self-hosted Xano runs on infrastructure you operate: you choose the CA for its TLS certificate and keep the
private key in your own HSM or key vault, in country.
You also own the trust store: confirm the Node and Composer bundles reject the October 2026 eMudhra chains.
